title: Factory Design Template Config
description: Schema for scaffolding Hatch factory topology/config from docs/skills/factory-design/templates.

target_repo.description: Repo where product work is executed and merged.

infra_issue_repo.description: Repo where factory design/runtime bugs are filed and tracked.

entry_graph.description: DOT entrypoint path for the supervisor outer loop (repo-root relative).

model_overrides.description: Model/provider overrides by node id and role name.

nodes.description: Per-node model overrides keyed by DOT node id.

llm_model.description: Model id used for this node (e.g. openai/gpt-5.3-codex).

llm_provider.description: Provider id used for this node (e.g. openrouter).

reasoning_effort.description: Optional reasoning effort hint for this node.

roles.description: Per-role model overrides keyed by role name (supervisor, coder, reviewer, merger, judge, triage_writer).

llm_model.description: Default model id for all nodes run by this role.

llm_provider.description: Default provider id for all nodes run by this role.

capacity_limits.description: Concurrency, retry, and stale-run controls used by supervisor/wave routing.

max_goal_runs_per_tick.description: Maximum goals decomposed in one supervisor tick.

max_issues_per_wave.description: Maximum issues executed in one wave before roll-forward.

review_max_attempts.description: Maximum coder↔reviewer loop attempts before terminal routing.

stale_run_minutes.description: Minutes before a run/wave is treated as stale for recovery sweep.

state_storage_path.description: Path to runtime state directory (e.g. .hatch or custom state root).

self_report_infra_bugs.description: If true, supervisor may file infra bugs automatically to infra_issue_repo.

worktree_strategy.description: Worktree/branch strategy for coder execution and merge flow.

local_repo_path.description: Absolute or repo-relative filesystem path used by local CLI/tool commands.

infra_monitoring_repo.description: Optional repo used for operational dashboards, monitoring artifacts, and incident summaries.
